parts.label: (a)
parts.stem:
The mass spectrum of compound $\mathbf{X}$, $\text{C}_5\text{H}_{10}\text{O}_2$, is recorded.

The peak heights of the $M$ and $M+1$ peaks are 22.65 and 1.25 respectively.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text:
Use these data to show that there are five carbon atoms present in one molecule of $\mathbf{X}$.

Show your working.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
The mass spectrum has a peak at $m/e = 57$.

Complete the equation to show the fragmentation of $\mathbf{X}$ to produce this peak.

$$[\text{C}_5\text{H}_{10}\text{O}_2]^+ \rightarrow + $$

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: State the use of TMS and $\text{CDCl}_3$ in NMR spectroscopy.

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem:
The proton NMR spectrum of compound $\mathbf{X}$, $\text{C}_5\text{H}_{10}\text{O}_2$, is shown.

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text:
By considering both the relative peak areas and their $\delta$ values, use the Data Booklet to

• deduce the part of the molecule that produces the peak at $\delta 2.2$,

• deduce the part of the molecule that produces the peaks at $\delta 1.2$ and $\delta 3.5$,

• deduce the part of the molecule that produces the peak at $\delta 4.0$.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text:
When reacted with aqueous alkaline iodine, $\mathbf{X}$ produces a yellow precipitate.

Use this information and your answers to (c)(i) to suggest a structure for $\mathbf{X}$.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Compound $\mathbf{W}$ is an ester with the molecular formula $\text{C}_5\text{H}_{10}\text{O}_2$.

The proton NMR spectrum of $\mathbf{W}$ contains only two peaks.

The relative areas of these two peaks are in the ratio 9 : 1.

Suggest a structure for this ester, $\mathbf{W}$.

parts.label: (e)
parts.stem: Compound $\mathbf{V}$ is a carboxylic acid which contains a chiral centre. It also has the molecular formula $\text{C}_5\text{H}_{10}\text{O}_2$.

parts.label: (e)(i)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by the term chiral centre.
